script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The comparison casts the LORD in the role of a friend texting instructions. Comparisons must stay on the human side of the moment.
It says the warning sounds, but the passage says the people were told to listen for the horn. It does not say the horn sounded.
“He isn't whispering this one” gives the LORD a vocal tone the passage does not describe.
It says the offerings are on the altar, but the passage does not mention an altar.
The errands line makes light of a warning about an armed enemy and terror.
It says the people are mourning, but the passage calls them to mourn; it does not say they have done so.
“Close in sound to the others” makes an unfounded comparison: strangers does not sound close to both rebels and servants.
It says the furnace contains ore, lead, bronze, iron and silver. The passage uses those materials in its refining picture but does not say they are all in a furnace.
